acceptanceCriteria: A webpack/vite resolve.alias (or equivalent bundler alias) that maps an external-looking package name onto repository code is read, and a relay or chain import through it is treated as a possible table holder, or the result is UNKNOWN.
A failing-before fixture proves the gap.
body: Follow-up from V1-1061 (GitHub #705) review round 12, recorded as a Limit in docs/build-log/2026-10-09-v1-1061-appmap-enum-barrel.md. appmap's StateConstants chain-binding check exempts external packages; bundler aliases (webpack/vite resolve.alias) that map an external-looking name onto repository code are not read, so such a name is still treated as external and a relay through it is not counted as a possible holder, allowing false certainty. tsconfig/jsconfig paths and baseUrl are already resolved before the package test (internal/contextindex/webresolve.go resolveBare).
title: appmap: bundler resolve.alias onto repository code is treated as an external package in the StateConstants chain check
